rules.hint: Enter a station address that is unique in the logical net before release.
rules.title: Bus address missing or duplicate

rules.hint: Switch the termination on at both ends of the segment and off everywhere between them.
rules.title: Termination

rules.hint: Restore the referenced record, or remove the reference with the quick fix.
rules.title: Dangling reference

rules.hint: Take ours or theirs for each conflict with ew merge resolve, or delete the record that conflicts.
rules.title: Conflict records present

rules.hint: Renumber the newer device with the quick fix, or give one of the records another number.
rules.title: Collision after a merge

rules.hint: Renumber the page into its section's folio range, or move it to the section that owns the range.
rules.title: Folio outside its section

rules.hint: Give one of the pages another folio; two pages never share a folio.
rules.title: Folio collision

rules.hint: Remove the override to print the bound project value again, or keep it if the page needs its own text.
rules.title: Title-block override

rules.hint: Shorten the generated table of contents or its page entries so that its page count settles.
rules.title: TOC fixpoint not reached

rules.hint: Add a report block of that kind, or exclude the records from the report on purpose.
rules.title: Report coverage gap

rules.hint: Choose a colour code of the core colour standard, for example BN instead of BR.
rules.title: Invalid core colour

rules.hint: Use the core as the cable part defines it, or choose the part that has this core.
rules.title: Core differs from the part

rules.hint: Enter a manual length, route the cable in the layout, or assign a part with a fixed length.
rules.title: Cable without length

rules.hint: Add the cable that leaves the location and assign its cores to the wires.
rules.title: External connection without cable

rules.hint: Assign the core to one connection only, or use another core of the cable.
rules.title: Core assigned twice

rules.hint: Connect the shield to an earthing point, or mark it as not connected on purpose.
rules.title: Shield not connected

rules.hint: Assign a part from the library, or mark the device as supplied by others.
rules.title: Device without part

rules.hint: Complete the part's data in the library and update the embedded copy.
rules.title: Incomplete part data

rules.hint: Replace the placeholder with the real part before the release.
rules.title: Placeholder part

rules.hint: Enter the value that is still marked TBD before the release.
rules.title: Open Tbd value

rules.hint: Remove contacts from the drawing, or choose a part with enough main and auxiliary contacts.
rules.title: Auxiliary contacts exceed the part

rules.hint: Place a representation of the device in the schematic, or delete the device.
rules.title: Device not in the schematic

rules.hint: Add the missing children to an order code of the assembly, or remove them from the assembly.
rules.title: Order codes do not cover the children

rules.hint: Place the matching interruption point with the same name, or remove this one.
rules.title: Unpaired interruption point

rules.hint: Keep one source per name: set the other sources to target, or flag exactly one point as the star source.
rules.title: Ambiguous interruption point

rules.hint: Restore the default anchor policy, or move the anchor into a cell that holds the graphics.
rules.title: Cross-reference cell invalid

rules.hint: Enlarge the text style, or change the texts to a style that prints at least at the minimum height.
rules.title: Text below minimum height

rules.hint: Give the text one of the project's text styles instead of a free size.
rules.title: Unstyled text size

rules.hint: Move ratings and technical data out of the description into their typed fields.
rules.title: Description lint

rules.hint: Replace the graphic line by a connection, so that it takes part in the connectivity.
rules.title: Graphic line on a CP

rules.hint: Remove the waiver, or correct its target to the finding it was meant for.
rules.title: Waiver matches nothing

rules.hint: Report the defect; the rule's findings in that scope are missing until it is fixed.
rules.title: Rule not evaluated

rules.hint: Restore the pack's data file or trust the project, so that the pack can run.
rules.title: Rule pack not evaluated

rules.hint: Draw the working line, or close the port with a plug, a silencer or a blanking.
rules.title: Working port open

rules.hint: Bind each solenoid the valve part declares to one channel, and no channel to another coil.
rules.title: Coil bindings against solenoids

rules.hint: Keep the spare valve or blanking plate deliberately, or put a used valve at the position.
rules.title: Spare positions

rules.hint: Link the valve to the device its lines reach, or draw the lines to the device it drives.
rules.title: Drives target mismatch

rules.hint: Give each valve position one valve or blanking plate, and each module its own position.
rules.title: Occupancy

rules.hint: Split the source into smaller files, or remove the items above the limit, and import again.
rules.title: Input limit exceeded; item or file refused

rules.hint: Correct the item in the source, or draw it again in this project.
rules.title: Malformed or refused item skipped

rules.hint: Draw the missing connection or link again in this project.
rules.title: Unresolvable reference dropped

rules.hint: Nothing to do: this content has no counterpart in a project; redraw it if it is needed.
rules.title: Content dropped by design

rules.hint: Check the inferred object and confirm or split it.
rules.title: Object inferred, review

rules.hint: Nothing to do, or choose another text style if the substitute prints differently.
rules.title: Font substituted

rules.hint: Check the mapped value; revert it or choose another where the alias is wrong.
rules.title: Value mapped through an alias table

rules.hint: Map the value to one the project knows, with the quick fix where it offers one.
rules.title: Value kept as foreign or opaque text

rules.hint: Compare the derived text with the source's printed text and correct the one that is wrong.
rules.title: Print-equivalence deviation

rules.hint: Delete the record if it is no longer needed; otherwise keep it.
rules.title: Removed in the source, kept here

rules.hint: Compare the source's change with this project's and take over what is needed by hand.
rules.title: Changed in the source and here, kept here

rules.hint: Use the derived tag, or keep the stored label as a frozen tag.
rules.title: Stored label differs from the formula result

rules.hint: Merge the variants into one structure code and keep the others as aliases.
rules.title: Structure-code spelling variants

rules.hint: Convert the tag to the scheme where it conforms, or keep it frozen.
rules.title: Label kept as a frozen tag

rules.hint: Create the revisions the folios name and drop the per-page values.
rules.title: Per-folio title-block value conflict

rules.hint: Drop the override to print the project description again, or keep it.
rules.title: Per-folio description kept as an override

rules.hint: Nothing to do, or split the strip if its segments are separate strips.
rules.title: Strip segments merged into one strip

rules.hint: Apply the text style the slot kind names.
rules.title: Imported text styles not bound to slot kinds

rules.hint: Rename one side of the pair, or set the pairing to chain mode.
rules.title: Folio-report pair names differ

rules.hint: Link the slave to its master, or reduce the master's links.
rules.title: Slave without master, or master above its slaves

rules.hint: Switch the folio references to the folio label.
rules.title: Default folio-index formula

rules.hint: Set the junction's wiring to Chain where the source wired it so.
rules.title: Junction wiring assumed

rules.hint: Map the symbol to a function definition, or keep the generic black box.
rules.title: Element without function semantics

rules.hint: Nothing to do: each copy got its own record.
rules.title: Shared element UUID disambiguated

rules.hint: Give the device a label; its tag prints "?" until then.
rules.title: Unlabelled element, tag synthesised

rules.hint: Place the device on a rail or on the mounting plate of its location's layout.
rules.title: Unplaced device

rules.hint: Place the device again with one of its parts, or give it back the part its placement realises.
rules.title: Part use not on the device

rules.hint: Move the device to the layout of its own location, or correct its location.
rules.title: Location mismatch

rules.hint: Move one of the overlapping objects until their footprints no longer overlap.
rules.title: Collision

rules.hint: Place the device on a carrier it fits, within the carrier and the usable area of the plate.
rules.title: Carrier incompatible

rules.hint: Place the assembly's parent first and its members next to it, in the order of their positions.
rules.title: Assembly order

rules.hint: Unfreeze the tag to take the derived value, or keep it frozen if the deviation is intended.
rules.title: Tag deviates from the scheme

rules.hint: Unfreeze the value to take the derived one, or keep it frozen if the deviation is intended.
rules.title: Frozen value deviates

rules.hint: Change the channels' addresses until none overlap, or let them take automatic addresses.
rules.title: Address overlap

rules.hint: Give the channel an address inside its module's range, or correct the module's start.
rules.title: Address outside the module

rules.hint: Choose a bit inside the width of a unit.
rules.title: Bit index out of range

rules.hint: Give each channel its own symbol.
rules.title: Duplicate symbol

rules.hint: Give the channel an address, or mark it unused.
rules.title: Used channel without address

rules.hint: Rebind the channel the part's map assigns, or correct the part's PLC section.
rules.title: Binding differs from the part map

rules.hint: Enter the address before release.
rules.title: Tbd address

rules.hint: Separate the potentials, correct the definition, or declare the bond that joins them.
rules.title: Type or voltage conflict

rules.hint: Declare exactly one 0 V–PE bond for a PELV potential, and none for a SELV potential.
rules.title: PELV or SELV bonding

rules.hint: Declare an FE–PE bond, or connect the pin to functional earth.
rules.title: FE pin on PE

rules.hint: Use green-yellow only for protective conductors; give the wire another colour.
rules.title: GNYE on a non-PE potential

rules.hint: Use another colour for the wire, or a cable whose blue core carries the neutral.
rules.title: BU on a non-N conductor

rules.hint: Increase the protective conductor's cross-section to the required size.
rules.title: PE undersized

rules.hint: Connect the PE potentials of the location, for example through the rail bonding of the terminals.
rules.title: PE island

rules.hint: Connect the connection point, or mark it unused.
rules.title: Unconnected CP

rules.hint: Draw the junction so that one end feeds it, or set its wiring order.
rules.title: Junction feed ambiguous

rules.hint: Remove the wire that closes the ring, or confirm that the ring is intended.
rules.title: Ring in the drawing graph

rules.hint: Move the contact into the line conductor, or use a device that opens L and N together.
rules.title: N switching

rules.hint: Give the physical wire one set of properties, or split it into separate wires.
rules.title: Physical-wire conflict

rules.hint: Give the wires of one potential the same wire number, or separate the potentials.
rules.title: Wire-number conflict

rules.hint: Remove the override; it sets the value the wire takes anyway.
rules.title: Redundant override

rules.hint: Keep one definition of the potential, or rename the interruption points to one name.
rules.title: Two potential names

rules.hint: Wire the load's return side to the return conductor of its supply (0 V, N), or link it to the module's return pin.
rules.title: Load not returned

rules.hint: Correct the designation to the reference designation syntax of IEC 81346.
rules.title: Designation does not parse

rules.hint: Remove the separator from the code, or use a structure level instead.
rules.title: Separator in a structure code

rules.hint: Use the suggested letter code, or keep the tag if the classification is intended.
rules.title: Letter code against function

rules.hint: Give one of the devices another designation.
rules.title: Duplicate designation

rules.hint: Avoid the letters I and O in a letter code; choose another letter.
rules.title: Reserved letters

rules.hint: Replace the character by its plain Latin form.
rules.title: Confusable character

rules.hint: Merge the structure nodes whose codes differ only in spelling.
rules.title: Structure-code variants

rules.hint: Set the author, then let another party approve the saved revision; approve again after a content edit.
rules.title: Four eyes

rules.hint: Recompute the stale result and commit it again before the release.
rules.title: Stale committed computation

rules.hint: Give the revision a label in the project's label format that follows every earlier label.
rules.title: Revision label order

rules.hint: Give the terminal a designation.
rules.title: Terminal without designation

rules.hint: Renumber the strip, or give one of the terminals another designation.
rules.title: Duplicate designation

rules.hint: Remove the field-side wire, or make the terminal a used terminal.
rules.title: Spare wired on the field side

rules.hint: Bridge only neighbouring terminals of one strip, or move the terminals together.
rules.title: Bridge group invalid

rules.hint: Clear the rail bonding, or make the terminal a PE terminal.
rules.title: Rail bonding on a non-PE terminal

rules.hint: Connect the terminal into the wire, or move it off the wire.
rules.title: Terminal on a wire it does not join
